title: Hosted CI provider
description: Runs a service's generated pipeline, which calls the platform's pinned shared pipeline and signs images with a short-lived identity; runs STEGO's own suites and gates, and keeps the proof run and release decision attestations that its attestation step signs.

title: Konflux
description: Runs the Konflux standard pipeline from a service's generated PipelineRun, with the STEGO checks, and signs images with Tekton Chains.

title: Argo CD
description: Reads a service's delivery object, Kubernetes base and the platform's overlay from version control, and applies them.
